excerpt.zh: 现在我们重建并殖民了[Root.GetStarName]环形世界上的一个可居住区段，是时候决定如何处理这些处于冷冻状态的克隆体了。
excerpt.en: Now that we have colonized a reconstructed segment of the [Root.GetStarName] Ring World, we must decide what is to be done with the alien clones left behind in cryostasis on the megastructure's habitat sections.

texts.zh: 现在我们重建并殖民了[Root.GetStarName]环形世界上的一个可居住区段，是时候决定如何处理这些处于冷冻状态的克隆体了。
texts.en: Now that we have colonized a reconstructed segment of the [Root.GetStarName] Ring World, we must decide what is to be done with the alien clones left behind in cryostasis on the megastructure's habitat sections.

label.zh: 就让他们继续处于休眠状态吧，正好作为纪念。
label.en: Leave them in stasis, as a monument.

label.zh: 将他们解冻，加入到我们的劳动力人口中。
label.en: Thaw them out. They can join our workforce.

label.zh: 将他们解冻，我们会照顾好他们的。
label.en: Thaw them out. We will care for them.

label.zh: 他们将作为有益健康的食材为[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]作出贡献。
label.en: They will make healthy fodder for our [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural].
